name: flin-gtm-mcp
description: Read-only Google Tag Manager: inspect accounts, containers, tags, triggers and versions.

client_id.title: OAuth client ID
client_id.description: Google OAuth Desktop app client ID. Enable the Tag Manager API in that Google Cloud project.

client_secret.title: OAuth client secret
client_secret.description: Secret belonging to the same Google OAuth Desktop app client.

long_description: Read-only Google Tag Manager access. Enter your Google Desktop app OAuth client ID and client secret, then request Google authentication. On restart, loads the newest stable compatible 0.2.x server from PyPI (>=0.2.4,<0.3.0). Running sessions keep their version. Google tokens stay in local private files; the same client ID preserves login. Use connection_status for local setup and running version; gtm_list_accounts checks live access. Internet is required for updates; see SUPPORT.md for the installed-environment fallback.
